initial_facts.title: Cache identity includes ruleset name, revision, and input
initial_facts.description: A cached score is valid only for the same integer input and the same immutable ruleset identity (name, revision). Different rulesets and revisions may produce different scores. Changing rule behavior requires a new revision; two rulesets with the same name and revision have identical behavior. Keying only by input or name can return stale scores.

initial_facts.title: Reuse successful results within a service instance
initial_facts.description: Repeated scoring of the same input and ruleset version must reuse the successful result, including zero. Reuse avoids repeating the injected evaluator, which represents expensive work. Failed evaluations propagate and remain retryable; failures are not cached. Cache storage is local to a service instance and is not required to survive restart.
